title: The Cellar Lock
prompt: The wine cellar has a 4-digit lock. Lord Voss always said the code was the year his vintage was laid down.
hint: Look at the label on the port decanter in the ballroom.
explanation: 1887, printed on the port label (tell players it's on the decanter in the Ballroom).

title: The Quiet Way Down
prompt: Nobody in the ballroom saw anyone go to the cellar. Starting from the Ballroom, tap the rooms someone would pass through to reach the Wine Cellar unseen.
explanation: Ballroom, Pantry, Wine Cellar: the servants' stair from the pantry.
